newsitem.title: UK: Quiet start to week on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Quiet start to week on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: Buyers were reluctant to show their hands on the UK meals and feeds market despite lower asking prices on Monday.

Lower Chicago soybean futures at the close on Friday coupled with the expected arrival of fresh supplies of soybeans at the mills triggered falls of one to five stg a tonne in high protein soymeal prices, but buyers were holding back.
"It's the same old story of buyers holding back on a falling market for lower prices tomorrow," said a trader.
